gates.title: UGOS API preflight is read-only
gates.evidence: Only GET requests are used; no login, upload, Docker mutation, container exec, compose edit, or PublicLibrary write is attempted.

gates.title: UGOS auth inputs are not recorded
gates.evidence: cookie_present=false, query_token_present=false, x_ugreen_auth_present=false, authorization_present=false; values are not written to artifacts.

gates.title: UGOS desktop HTTP shell is reachable
gates.required_evidence: NAS desktop /desktop/ must be reachable before trying UGOS API collection.

gates.evidence: verify_is_login:http=200 code=1024, current_user:http=200 code=1024, docker_app_uid:http=200 code=1024, docker_container_list:http=200 code=9405, filemgr_share_list:http=200 code=1024, machine_common:http=200 code=1024

gates.title: UGOS session is authenticated
gates.evidence: verify_is_login code=1024, message=Login has expired, please login again!
gates.required_evidence: Provide an authenticated UGOS session through a temporary Cookie/X-Ugreen-Auth header; do not store NAS password in files or reports.

gates.title: UGOS Docker app context is ready
gates.evidence: docker_app_uid code=1024, message=Login has expired, please login again!, shape=object(no-keys)
gates.required_evidence: UGOS Docker app uid/context must be readable before browserless Docker evidence collection can replace SSH/desktop handoff.

gates.title: Docker container list is readable through UGOS API
gates.required_evidence: Container list must be readable before UGOS API can collect current-image and worker proof.

gates.title: UGOS API preflight does not approve deploy

next_actions: Keep using the portable NAS handoff kit as the primary evidence path until an authenticated UGOS API session is available.
Do not put NAS passwords in scripts, reports, shell history, or committed files.
If using the UGOS API path, provide a temporary authenticated Cookie/X-Ugreen-Auth header through environment variables only, then rerun this preflight.
Open the Docker app in the NAS desktop once, or provide the required UGOS Docker app context, then rerun this preflight.
If UGOS API stays blocked, run the already-transferred handoff kit from the NAS desktop or NAS shell and return admin-docker-release-inputs/.

result.summary: UGOS API path is not ready for browserless Docker evidence collection.
